title: Muon-induced high-energy neutrons at 4850 ft: an independent estimate of untagged single scatters above 8 MeV and the meaning of the 41-minute-earlier muon
question: Independently of LZ's MUSUN+GEANT4 simulation, how many untagged single 200-270 keV scatters do muon-induced rock neutrons produce in 220 d at 4850 ft, and are the 41-min (OD) and 127-min (TPC) previous-muon gaps unusual or causally relevant?
headline_result: Rebuilt from recalled muon flux (5.3e-9 cm^-2 s^-1), yield (3.5e-4 n/(mu g cm^-2)), spectrum, rock escape and water attenuation, muon-induced rock neutrons give 8.0e-4 untagged SS of any energy (LZ UL 4.6e-4, which decomposes as 2.303/1200 yr x 0.602 yr x 0.2 x 2) and 1.3e-5 (68% 3.3e-6-5.4e-5; corners 1.4e-7-1.9e-4) in 200-270 keV, confirming P013 without LZ's simulation; the 41-min OD gap has P=0.068 for GdLS-crossing muons (7e-5 for any tank muon, so the tag is high-threshold), the 127-min TPC gap P=0.30, and no causal channel (thermalisation <1 ms, beta-n emitters <=7 s and E_R<=61 keV) connects either muon to the event
key_numbers: muon rates tank 14/h (gap 4.3 min), GdLS envelope 3.9/h (15 min), TPC 0.57/h (105 min); P(>=41 min) 0.068 GdLS / 7e-5 tank; P(>=127|TPC) 0.30; MUSUN 2.1e9/1200 yr = 0.0555/s -> 1050 m^2; f(>8.2 MeV)=0.17, f(>100)=0.03; wall current >8.2 MeV 1.5e-11 cm^-2 s^-1; 334 enter tank (90/126/117 at 8-30/30-100/>100 MeV); 13.4 aimed at TPC; survival 2.5 m: 4e-8 (10 MeV), 6e-4 (20), 0.028 (50), 0.082 (>=100); 0.49 reach LXe; N_SS(any) 8.0e-4 (1.6e-4 with 4% untagged); N(200-270) 1.33e-5, 68% 3.3e-6-5.4e-5, corners 1.4e-7-1.9e-4; sensitivities f_untag x6, L_path x3, knee x2.4, lam_att x2.3, lam_esc x2, Y x2; crude untagged fraction 2-7% vs LZ 20%; P(muon within 1 ms) 3.9e-6; 9Li in water 7 per 220 d, E_R<=61 keV
model_or_mechanism: flux x yield x two-component spectrum x escape depth x direction -> rock current; tank receiving area + TPC geometric fraction; n-p removal Sigma = n_H sigma_H (8.2/E) + n_O sigma_nonel below 50 MeV, exponential lambda 0.7/1.0 m above; P013 mono-energetic SS MC; cos^3.5 zenith cylinder rate integral and exponential gaps
